title: Effect of machine arithmetic errors for multi-turn invariant curve destruction
summary: Using the example of three-dimensional Mira map, it is shown that the destruction of a multi-turn invariant curve can occur through the appearance of local multiple bends. It was found that, depending on the precision of machine arithmetic, a complication of the multi-turn invariant curve can be observed, which is a numerical artifact. Artifact can be avoided with increasing of machine arithmetic accuracy.
